card.title: I Earn My Seat
card.instruction: Behave as though belonging must be justified through performance. Make your competence visible whenever your right to participate feels uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you ask who invited me to the committee, I've balanced its accounts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You still need a membership vote.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you circulate the accounts with my application? Especially the savings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't vote tonight. Nobody's taken the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I have. Alphabetised, with action points. Shall I read the section where you need a treasurer?
